correctness.rationale: Each rung, two horizontals and diagonal is charged exactly once by the nine-state transfer. Explicit potentials at fields 0, 1, 2 satisfy all 243 inequalities with exact rational arithmetic, interpolation covers every nonnegative field, and periodic words attain the lower envelope for every circumference divisible by three. Zero-slack adjacency characteristic polynomials and Newton trace identities give complete exact ground-state counts and entropy. The independent exhaustive six-column enumeration agrees at five fields.

originality.rationale: No examined exact prior theorem includes row-dependent preferences for two different colors on the two rows. The 2009 explicit uniform-field triangular-strip transfer matrix is the closest object: its identical-color field on every site is not a stronger formula for the staggered-field Hamiltonian, since row-only color relabeling twists inter-row equality bonds. residual_risks: An unindexed treatment of site-dependent colored fields on the same triangular strip might already derive the same two thresholds or entropy formulas.

value.rationale: Two incompatible row-specific favored colors create a natural staggered-field defect to standard triangular-ladder Potts models. Exact classification for an infinite commensurate-size family, both critical fields, all field-regime multiplicities, a Lucas-number entropy spike and a different cubic Perron entropy spike is substantive magnetic and statistical-mechanical structure, not a one-off finite enumeration.
